stem:
Noah has 48 cookies. The model represents what he did with the cookies.

Based on the model, which of these could explain what Noah did with the cookies?

options.label: F
options.text: He put (48 ÷ 8) cookies into each of 8 bags and ate (2 × 6) of the cookies.

options.label: G
options.text: He put (48 ÷ 6) cookies into each of 8 bags and ate (2 × 8) of the cookies.

options.label: H
options.text: He put (48 − 6) cookies into each of 8 bags and ate (2 × 6) of the cookies.

options.label: J
options.text: He put (48 × 6) cookies into each of 8 bags and ate (2 + 6) of the cookies.

visual_elements: Diagram showing 8 bags arranged in a grid of 4 rows and 2 columns with cookie images inside each bag. The last row bags are crossed out.
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding division and multiplication applied to a model with visual information and eliminating incorrect options based on the model. It involves reasoning about the relationship between total cookies, groups, and eaten cookies, which is more than recalling a fact or direct computation.
